en.title: Minimum Round-Trip Cost with Return Strictly After Departure
en.description:
The indices of the two arrays each represent time, and the values are flight costs; the return index j must be strictly greater than the departure index i. The arrays may have different lengths. Find the minimum total cost; if no valid pair exists, this site additionally outputs −1, without adding a guarantee that a solution always exists.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; bounds supplemented where the source lacks them and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the specification.
en.input: Input, in order, the departure array length n, n integers, the return array length m, and m integers. The original gives no value bounds and no guarantee of non-negativity or equal lengths; this site uses 0≤n,m≤200000 and costs in −10^9..10^9.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 2; -1; 3. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Scan the return time j, adding departure j−1 (if it exists) to the running minimum; update the answer with the minimum departure cost so far plus the current return cost.
